topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for logical resources, file artifacts, storage bindings, revisions and atomic replacement state.

semantics.identity_rule: Logical resource, file artifact, path, storage location and content revision identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: move/copy/replace operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing storage metadata grants no data authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
